notes.title: Patch 1.1.04: Double Honor Event, QoL & Fixes
notes.notes:
Patch 1.1.04


New / Changes
 Honor gain per wave slightly increased


 Temporary Extra Honor Event: earn double Honor for now — enjoy!


 Minor color tweaks added to fusion animations




Fixes
 Fixed bug where the Lighthouse persisted after a Meta reset


 Fixed Tower Focus Priorities incorrectly transferring to other tower types/groups


 Fixed rare issue where trees could spawn on seals (symbols) in later biomes


 Fixed issue where tower SFX could be lost


 Fixed older saves sometimes not ending a run correctly


 Fixed occasional incorrect buff-arrow indicators from auras (Runestone / Reaper)


 Fixed case where Multitude (Generalist Banner) could offer 0 banners


 Fixed Tornado-family spells sometimes disappearing in front of barriered enemies (they now shatter correctly)




Adjustments
 Bloody Chain (Arc x Arrow Fusion) no longer requires Barbed Arrows to propagate Bleed


 Fusions can no longer be skipped by leaving the game


 Starting a new Meta+ run no longer removes the Wave 10 starter bonus


 Tutorial refined for clarity and safety


 Blood Whip statistics accounting adjusted


 Jump behavior adjusted for Celestial Jumps (Runestone x Arc Fusion) and Charged Arrows (Arc x Arrow Fusion)


 Changed key bindings are now shown for the spell in the Statistics view




Improvements
 Non-essential Lighthouse upgrade tile choices are no longer offered when all options would be identical at the end of the path


 Doom Cold (Raven x Frost Fusion) is no longer overwritten by weaker Frost effects


 Duplicate items can no longer appear in queues (e.g., Lighthouse & Market) → prevents empty offers


 Meta+ mode node display improved


 Minor UI tweaks


 Further tuning of tower animations




Got ideas, questions, or just want to hang out? Join our Discord and be part of the community.

notes.title: Version 1.1 is Live: New Tower, Skin Shop (Honor), New Season, New Fusions
notes.notes:
Version 1.1Wings of Chaos
The 9th tower has arrived: Chaos Reaper 
A ferocious close-range powerhouse that shreds clustered enemies and breaks barriers. Comes with fresh Fusions and new synergies to explore:


[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gs_h52mK4eE"][/dynamiclink]
New / Changes
 NEW Tower (+4 Fusions)


 NEW Skin Shop (no real money – Honor only)


 NEW Season (including new leaderboards)


 NEW Fusions (two more are coming soon; for now there will be only one banner choice in two spots)


 NEW Spells


 NEW Relics


 2 replaced Oracle paths


 2 replaced starter bonuses


 1 replaced and 1 new hero attribute


 Overhauled UI
   
Adjustments
 Arrow Tower range: 3 → 4


 Bosses can no longer perform the same boss skill multiple times in Meta Mode or Ascensions


 Honor is now awarded after Wave 40 in addition to Elite/Boss kills


 Wave 50: barrier health reduced
 
Relic Changes
 Coinfall: 2 → 4


 Magic Contract: 10% → 15%


 Scope Lens: 15 → 25


 Necrotic Curse: 80% → 75%


 Golden Incentive: 3 → 5


 Timber Stockpile: waves 10 → 20


 Elixir of Aleboost: 20% → 30%



Burden Cart: 3 → 2 affected Outposts 


 Distant Wing: -0.8 → -0.6


 Fractured Arrow: 3% → 5%


 Frost Cube: 120 → 125%


 Galdra Earrings: 10% → 15%


 Rikur’s Axe: 10% → 15%
 
Building Changes
 University – Best Selection: 10× → 6×


 Hero Tower Specializations: share of original spell damage increased 70% → 80%
 
Banner Changes
 Ring of Death now executes enemies under 15% (was 10%) health


 Darkness: 3/4/7% → 6/8/14%


 Doom Scattering – Base: 160 → 250%; Upgrades: 18/23/42 → 45/60/105%
 

 Skyfall Arrows: +20% → +50% arrow damage


 Glacial Nova: 5 → 10% chance 

 Bloody Chain (Arrow x Arc Fusion): Base 15 → 10%; Upgrades 5/7/11 → 3/4/7%
  
Meta+ Nodes
 Small extra-shot (Arrow) nodes: 1% → 2%


 Mortar Meta+ AoE: 1% → 2%


 Slow amount reduced: 7% → 5%
 
Hero Changes
 Resources on map: 10% → 15%


 Spell damage upgrades: +20% → +50% spell damage


 Beer productivity: 10% → 25%


 Stone/Wood/Gold per worker (respective buildings): +2/2/1 → +4/4/2


 Gold per worker per wave: 1 → 4


 Rare banner chance: 7% → 10%


 Power Spike (Spell): +4% → +3% spell damage

Fixes
 Fixed Tornado “Endless Enemy Defense” bug (now interacts correctly with barriers) 


 Fixed a bug that could skip waves 


 Fixed excessive bonus from Plate Crusher (Rare Relic) when combined with Basic Training (University) 


 Weakness is now applied correctly during Jumps in Endless Mode 


 Fixed slow calculation on higher waves (enemies could exceed the intended slow cap)

 
Improvements
 Fixed UI glitch in Discoveries when displaying perks


 Better price refresh rates for tower unlock costs


 Minor scaling optimizations for higher Endless waves


 Higher Bleed stack amounts now possible (previously stacks could disappear at very high values)



Season 3 starts
NEW SEASON: A new season has begun and the following badges are awarded for the previous season:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063720/c34825d78c28ae72fe02eee9d4970cbc3d4d17d3.png"]




Roadmap Update: v1.1 Delivered
Version 1.1 is out, which means the roadmap beats shown in the image are now shipped: 
Q1 Launch ✔️
Q2 Core Expansion ✔️
Q3 Major Update 1.1 ✔️

Looking Ahead: we’ll continue with steady, incremental updates as they make sense; shaped by your feedback and our still-not-empty backlog. 😄



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063720/4b369f6cd55a51ac09d6995c5c62a6b256372475.png"]

Thank you for all the incredible feedback across Discord, Steam reviews, YouTube, and the forums! We read every message, and the beta feedback in particular was invaluable.



Got ideas or questions (or just want to hang out)? Join our Discord and be part of the community!

notes.title: NEW Game Mode: Meta+ / Pathing Choices / Patch 1.0.692
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.692


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063720/cf079d28206443ddc6333d34fd69fa5387bd922d.png"]


New / Changes
NEW Gamemode: Meta+ Mode

NEW Lighthouse Meta Upgrade: A new Pathing Choice System has been added    

NEW Mortar Banner: Crescendo has been replaced    

7 NEW Relics    

Arcane Rift (University, War Tree, Spell Damage+) now increases spell damage multiplicatively    

Two new targeting options for Healer towers:     

Self-healing enemies     

Enemies that heal nearby units via aura    

Fire Arrows (Mortar x Arrow Fusion) now also transfers Burn via Charged Arrows (Arrow x Arc Fusion)    

Endless Damage Reduction scaling adjusted    

Endless Spell Base Damage Modifier increased – but now only applied at 7% for Lightning Surge-triggered spells    
Fixes
Improved leaderboard appearance, especially for new players    

Fixed issues with leaderboard entry overwrites    

Fixed saving of tower upgrade costs    

Multitude (Generalist Banner) now only affects banner rewards, not chests/Lighthouse/etc., as described    

Burn no longer deals damage to immune enemies until the immunity ends    
Adjustments
Marks of Ascension (Rare Relic) removed from the loot pool for the first 9 waves    

Raven Feather (Legendary Relic) downgraded to Rare    

Vulnerability (Shadow Tower Banner) now reduces block/armor by a flat amount instead of a percentage    

Defense reduction adjusted: 

-10/15/25% → -4/6/10%    

Vulnerability now auto-banishes once -50% block/armor reduction is reached    

Doom Scattering (Raven x Tornado Fusion) adjusted: fixed chance and added multiplier    

Unchained Rage Buff:     

Initial: 20% → 30%     

Upgrades: +6/8/14% → +9/12/21%    

Supernova (Volcano Unique) Damage Multiplier reduced: 5000% → 4000%    

Collapse (Tornado Banner) now capped at 25% Crit and 25 Stone Production    

Spell Evolutions of “Arcane Strike” adjusted    

Valknut’s Ascendant (Legendary Relic) now only applies to manually triggered tower upgrades    
Improvements
Performance boost: faster, smoother gameplay    

Volcano Mortar VFX optimized – significantly improved performance    

Save game stability improved    

Leaderboard stability improved    

Starter selection now includes a reroll button    

Fixed Runeforge icon highlight (yellow) when all 4 upgrades are completed    

Dual monitor behavior improved    

Critical Breach (Frost x Arc Fusion) now applies to all slow sources    

Reroll now consistently considers the Statue Tower when “Blessing of Choice” is selected    

Fixed damage upgrade tooltip bug after selecting Generalist Banners    

Banner list now scrollable with arrow buttons when too many are on screen    

Camera movement speed can now be adjusted separately for mouse and keyboard (WASD) in settings    

Auto-banish for Tempest-Stopper (Tornado Banner) fixed    

Fixed Fusion/Unique Banner exploits    

Statistics display and tracking corrected    

Rare boss spawn location bug fixed    

Fixed bug that allowed picking two Generalist Banners    

Optimized execution order of University and Oracle effects    

Fixed bug where Runestone Towers incorrectly applied Burn    

Fixed HP scaling of self-healing enemies at Wave 80+    

Relic overlay now correctly displays under the eye icon    

Shift-click in Trading Post now toggles between min and max stack size    

ESC now works in more cases (e.g. opens settings from title screen)    

Fixed bug causing inconsistent Ascension boss skills in later waves    

Fixed jump damage reduction interaction with Endless Defense    

Translations, text, and tooltip fixes    

Tavern’s Althing bonus now displayed in top left of building status    

Reroll logic in market (with Uni perk) improved    

Fixed Frost Magician bug when spell energy is empty    

Herbal Potions (Druid House Upgrade) now blocked when at full HP    

Fixed Runestone beam animation bug    

Fixed map generation bugs    

Effects on enemies now reflect real-time status more accurately    

Price update behavior improved    

Relics in “Discoveries” are now sorted by rarity    

Fixed bug where two statues could appear simultaneously    

Vision Chest now shows a counter of remaining unopened chests    

Improved University UI – wave completion bugs during defense phase resolved    

Armor of barrier carriers no longer applies to the barrier itself    


Roadmap Update
This also gives us an opportunity to update our roadmap. The yellow ticks indicate topics for which we've already partially delivered planned content in this patch - but as you can see, there's more on the way:


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063720/7acdf3a76d517e666e3e466bb931ec8fc584d485.png"]



Thanks again for all the great feedback we've received from the community - we read every message, whether it's on Discord, Steam reviews, YouTube comments, or Steam discussions. THANK YOU! Special thanks as well to everyone who provided feedback during the beta.

notes.title: NEW Season / NEW Banner System / Patch 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.5
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063720/ffc8a52ee93807843f8d54695c0dadc420a126a8.png

With this patch, we're delivering several milestone elements from our planned roadmap (see below), including:
[olist]
 launch a new season!
 add a new banner system
 deliver significant QoL and bug fixes!
[/olist]

New / Changes

 GENERALIST BANNER SYSTEM: Choose 2 banners from 5 different tower types and earn a powerful specialization as a reward!  
 NEW SEASON: A new season has begun – many things have changed. You can still view the results of the last season. 
The following badges are awarded for the previous season:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063720/42df58af2870b62a668d53b2a35f2f39306d7b4c.png
 Endless Mode Scaling Modifiers: Enemies gain special resistance scaling over time. In turn, spell base damage now scales as well.  
 Shadow Tornados (Tornado x Shadow Fusion) now trigger Darkness (Shadow Banner effect), but no longer trigger Overdose (Shadow Banner)  
 Frost spells now override Frost Tower effects (and cannot be overwritten by Frost Towers)  
 Reroll function for Hero Choice added via a new Hero Tower Meta Perk  
 Added button to open chests (for cases where visibility is blocked)  
 City-building icons now change color based on the upgrade completion of their respective building  


Major bug fixes

 Fixed special case of invisible chests  
 Fixed bug preventing spells from being triggered  
 Improved savegame stability  
 Fixed rare bug in later waves where bosses could become immortal
 Fixed rare bug in later waves where health bars disappeared


Adjustments

 Doom Scattering (Raven x Tornado Fusion):  
  Initial: 20% → 30%  
  Banner upgrades: 6/8/14% → 9/12/21%  
 Clinking Mastery (Raven x Frost Fusion):  
  Initial: 200% → 300%  
  Banner upgrades: 60/80/140% → 90/120/210%  
 Precision Shots (Arrow x Mortar Fusion):  
  Initial: 90% → 120%  
  Banner upgrades: 30/40/70% → 40/55/95%  
 Shadow Tornado (Tornado x Shadow Fusion):  
  Duration: 200 → 130  
  Banner Duration: 20/30/40 → 9/12/21  
  Damage: 400% → 200%  
  Banner Damage: 120/160/280% → 60/80/140%  
 Squall (Tornado Banner):  
  Initial: +73/87/130 → +90/120/210%  
  Upgrades: +43/57/100 → +60/80/140%  
 Stormbringer (Tornado Banner): +18/24/42% → +21/28/50%  
 Wide Blast (Volcano Mortar Banner): +15/20/35% → +20/27/47%  
 Runestone Tower Fire Rate: 7 → 6  
 Scorching (Runestone x Tornado Fusion):  
  Initial: 40% → 30%  
  Banner upgrades: 12/16/28% → 9/12/21%  
 Spiral of Pain (Shadow x Tornado Fusion):  
  Initial: 30% → 40%  
  Banner upgrades: 9/12/21% → 12/16/28%  
 Prism damage transfer from previous towers: 70% → 60%  
 Frost Tower:  
  Max Slow Amount: 80% → 75%  
  Freeze immunity after being frozen: 0.5s → 1s  
 Frost Magician Global Cooldown: 15s → 20s  
 Auto-banish of irrelevant perks after entering Endless Mode (e.g. more branching possible)  
 Removed downside from Guild Obligation (no longer disables Goldmine)  
 Removed downside from The One Standard (Fusions/Uniques no longer restricted)  
 Best Selection (University, Luck Tree): Chance for banners in chests: 5x → 10x  
 Path of Bounty: Next Boss HP Boost: 30% → 50%  
 Hero Tower Specializations now grant more of the original spell damage: 50% → 70%  
 Greedgem (Rare Relic): +100% → +200%  
 Seal of Constancy and Golden Incentive (Common Relics) have swapped downsides  
 Mill Specializations buffed: +4 Wheat per Worker, +20 passive Wheat production  
 All other Resource Building Specializations buffed: +2 per Worker  
 Buffed University Perks:  
  Luck Tree: Market rerolls: 2 → 3  
  War Tree: Enemy Analysis: +80% → +100% crit damage  
  Economy Tree:  
  - Trade Networks: 2 → 3 gold per ship  
  - Golden Era: 60 → 80 gold per wave  
  - Conservation: 20% → 30% worker cost reduction  
  - Honey Ale: 40% → 60% beer bonus productivity  
 Starter Bonuses to choose, when you start a new run:  
  Wheat: 40 → 50  
  Stone: 50 → 55  


Improvements

 Performance optimization (especially with Runestone–Prism chains)  
 Trade stack size in the Trading Post can now exceed 100  
 Forges now display which towers are being buffed  
 Specialized Workshop now directly shows which tower will be affected  
 Improved perk refresh timing  
 Fixed bug where Enemy Bane achievement didn’t count on all difficulties  
 Clearing Master (Workshop Spec) now shows its effect when hovering over build resources  
 0-gold tower upgrades are now purchasable even when using Final Rags (debt relic)  
 VFX reduction setting now affects all visual effects  
 Message now appears if no more offers can be made due to empty loot pool (UI fades out)  
 Fixed bug where DPS of last wave in leaderboard was capped at 2.1b  
 Corrected Focus Rune (Runestone Banner) calculation  
 Holding right-click to move the map no longer cancels spells/tower/outpost placement  
 Improved visibility of high levels in Outpost heatmap  
 Fixed bug where Artifact of Determination expiration removed auto level-up on some towers  
 Fixed visual inconsistency where towers had no color difference on medium graphics  
 Adjusted relic counter position/size to avoid overlap  
 Fixed bug where chest drop tiles could block future frost/burn fields  
 Fixed cloning issue with tower level-up groups  
 Improved translations  
 Mouse buttons can now be assigned in keybindings  


Roadmap Update
This also allows us to update our roadmap - the yellow ticks visualize topics for which we have already partially delivered the scope of the planned content with the patch - but as you can see, there's more to come:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063720/056d458cc14fce4c3c0566085f744f70b83f84d5.png

Thanks again to all the valuable feedback from the community - we read everything, whether Discord, Review, Youtube comment or Steam Discussion post: THANK YOU! Also thanks to all the feedback from the beta - Reminder: If you want to help us test the next upcoming content: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3028310/view/506198441910601078

Got ideas, questions, or just want to hang out? Join our Discord and be part of the community.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.45
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.0.45

Bug Fixes

 Fixed healing calculation issues in Ascension-Endless mode (related to Vitalpierce Relic for Bleed)  
 Further crash optimizations and prevention related to Unity Error 0xc0000005  
 Fixed issues with uploading certain leaderboard entries  
 Fixed calculation and application problems with Ancient Knowledge (Legendary Relic affecting the University)  
 Fixed bug in counting progress for the "Dark Offering" achievement  
 Fixed an issue where clicking too fast during Specialization selection would deduct resources twice  
 Fixed a bug where the first boss effect in Ascensions incorrectly affected the Sacrifice malus  
 Marks of Ascension (Rare Relic) no longer applies to level 20 towers  


Adjustments

 Thor’s Wrath (Arc Tower Unique) now also applies to Chained Arrows (Arrow x Arc Fusion)  
 Enemy weakening scaling from Comfort Mode no longer scales endlessly in Endless Mode  
 Specialized Workshop (Workshop Specialization) now permanently discounts the most built tower type — it no longer changes during the run  


Improvements

 Additional performance optimization  
 Improved phrasing and clarity in various texts  
 Minor UI enhancements  
 Tower animation slider now more thoroughly affects VFX elements (e.g. Ghost Raven)  


We can’t wait to let you try out upcoming features – feel free to join our public beta anytime:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3028310/view/506198441910601078

In the meantime, we’re continuing to work hard on further bug fixes – huge thanks again for all your reports! Performance improvements are also ongoing, and after that, we’ll shift our focus toward roadmap content and new features. 

Thanks for being part of the journey!
Your Stunforge Team
